scoreboard_title: Hanasui went big on Mega creators; Glad2Glow's Instagram engagement jumped
movers_title: Hanasui and Glad2Glow moved up; Timephoria's Instagram slipped

drivers.title: Hanasui seeded #cantikmuhanasui across a wider Instagram base
drivers.why: Hanasui's Instagram creators rose from 125 to 189, and 51 of them used #cantikmuhanasui, a tag only Hanasui used. Nano creators wrote 89% of creator posts; the top post drew only 20K views.
drivers.attention_to_action: Volume without reach on Instagram, and no cart there; the reach sat on TikTok, where four Mega posts carried 68% of creator views.

drivers.title: One 6.5M-view post lifted Glad2Glow's Instagram engagement
drivers.why: @sandrinna_11's post drew 6.5M views at 8.9% engagement, 23% of the brand's Instagram views, while creators fell from 441 to 211. Engagement rose from 0.5% to 2.5%.
drivers.attention_to_action: Instagram has no cart, and Glad2Glow's TikTok engagement fell to 0.9%: the lift is attention, not yet a sales push.

drivers.title: Timephoria's Instagram volume slipped below its range
drivers.why: Instagram posts fell to 66 and creators from 94 to 62, while TikTok held at 295 posts. The top Instagram post, by a makeup artist, drew 53K views, 65% of the week's views.
drivers.attention_to_action: No campaign tag took hold on Instagram this week; Timephoria's push stayed on TikTok, where its lip posts drew 4.6M views.

actions_title: What Paragon does next: five moves, two before 6.6

actions.title: Book Mega creators for the next launch
actions.detail: Hanasui's four Mega posts carried 68% of its creator views, and Mega creators earn a 66K median per post against 540 for Nano. Book two Mega creators for Make Over's next launch before 6.6.

actions.title: Turn payday talk into cart posts
actions.detail: Paragon wrote 40 payday captions with promo language in 5% of its posts, while Glad2Glow ran 19 double-date captions and 11% promo. Brief payday creators with cart links and one offer line.

actions.title: Give Emina's TikTok reach a cart
actions.detail: Emina's TikTok views reached 93.8M, 20.4% of the panel, at 0.3% engagement. Find the posts that carried it, then put cart links and a review series behind the same products.

actions.title: Post fewer, bigger TikToks from brand accounts
actions.detail: Paragon's 455 brand-account TikToks drew 34.6M views at a 3K median. Cut the weakest daily posts and put media behind the two or three that clear that median on their own.

actions.title: Pilot a seeding tag for one hero product
actions.detail: Hanasui's #cantikmuhanasui reached 116 accounts and 156 posts. Pilot one tag for Wardah's next hero product with one-post briefs and track its reach week by week.

portfolio_note: Emina's TikTok views reached 93.8M, 20.4% of the panel; Labore and Tavi also posted far more than usual.

tiers.title: Four Mega posts gave Hanasui 68% of its creator views
tiers.takeaway: Paragon's Mega creators are 1% of its creator posts but 31% of views, and Mid-tier adds 47%; Nano is 82% of posts for 7%.

products.title: Paragon's cushion posts carried views; its lip posts did not
products.takeaway: Paragon's 338 cushion posts drew 11.1M views and 413 lip posts 3.2M; Hanasui's niacinamide serum sat in the cart on 11 posts for 5.8M.

posting.title: Glad2Glow warmed up for 6.6; Paragon talked payday
posting.takeaway: Glad2Glow ran 19 double-date captions with promo language in 11% of posts; Paragon wrote 40 payday captions but promo in only 5%.

patterns.title: Three Glad2Glow affiliates posted 58 times for 2.5M views
patterns.takeaway: @pretty.withcaa led Glad2Glow's affiliate burst, while Hanasui's #cantikmuhanasui spread 156 posts over 116 accounts; Paragon's 30 affiliate accounts posted 292 times for 1.1M.
